projects.name: IDP — Intelligent Document Processing
highlights: Building backend services in Python and Django REST Framework for Cozentus IDP — an AI-first pipeline that captures, extracts, validates, and integrates logistics document data into ERP/TMS systems.
Working with LLM and OCR/NLP extraction flows that read multi-format logistics documents (bills of lading, commercial invoices, customs paperwork) from email, EDI, scans, and portals.
Implementing validation and confidence-aware processing so extracted fields are checked against business rules, with uncertain cases routed for human review instead of silent failure.
Exposing document processing outcomes through REST APIs so clean, structured data can be pushed into downstream logistics and supply-chain systems.
Focusing on technical reliability of the capture → extract → validate → integrate loop used across high-volume supply-chain document workflows.

projects.name: SOLVIQAI — AI Placement Simulator
highlights: Integrated Disha job portal with SOLVIQAI via SSO token validation, assessment packages, and result webhooks for seamless partner-driven hiring simulations.
Engineered AI question generation using Cohere LLM with fallback logic for aptitude, soft skills, coding, GD, and AI interview rounds across multi-round placement packages.
Designed proctored exam UI (fullscreen mode, question navigator, timers) with webcam monitoring and snapshot uploads for exam integrity.
Delivered scoring and reporting module with round-wise analytics and automated result push to Disha after assessment completion.

projects.name: DISHA — Job Portal
highlights: Built end-to-end campus hiring workflow — corporate JD creation, admin university assignment, university approval, student applications (portal and tokenized public JD links), shortlist/reject with SOLVIQ assessments and manual screening, offer letter upload and tracking.

Integrated SOLVIQ assessment platform with JWT-based student access, automated result callbacks, and corporate/university pipelines so recruiters can run structured tests alongside manual shortlisting.
Developed resume builder with live preview and export, plus AI-powered resume/career-align analysis to help students improve profiles before applying.
Led multi-role platform (student, university, corporate, admin) on Next.js and FastAPI with PostgreSQL multi-tenancy, role-based dashboards, analytics, and AWS EC2 deployment.

projects.name: CODE GENERATOR — Café Management System
highlights: Built a custom low-code platform where users fill a web form and a fully functional, deployed café management website is automatically generated — including separate admin and customer-facing dashboards.

Engineered real-time order flow: customers place orders from the customer dashboard, Kitchen Tickets (KT) are instantly generated in the admin panel with alerts, and invoices are auto-generated upon payment completion.
Developed an analytics dashboard for admins to monitor revenue trends, order volumes, and performance metrics across time periods.
Integrated AWS Cognito for secure authentication and implemented branch-based CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments across environments.

projects.name: SUBSCRIPTION-BASED PAYMENT & BILLING SYSTEM
highlights: Developed a complete subscription and payment lifecycle system — from invoice generation and scheduled payment reminders to automated email/SMS notifications and digital bill receipt delivery.
Built automated workflows for invoice reminders, payment confirmation triggers, and receipt dispatch, reducing manual overhead in the billing process.
